data.name: DORM
data.detailed_description:
DORM - a first-person survival horror.

The game takes place in an old student dormitory in a provincial town in Eastern Europe. The dormitory is about to be closed down, and the last remaining students will soon leave this place. But they should have done it much sooner.

A Unique Setting

Modern times, late autumn, a provincial Eastern European town, an old Soviet-style corridor dorm — the perfect setting for a nightmare.

Gameplay

Here, the enemy is not a ghost in the walls — it's a tangible, brutal confrontation where your reflexes are the last line of defense. The rules change as you play: injuries slow you down, and the mechanics you've grown used to stop working. You're not just learning the rules of this nightmare — you're trying to survive them as they shift beneath your feet.

Extreme Violence and Explicit Content

The game features an abundance of violent scenes, gore, and explicit content. Meticulous attention is paid to detail and the anatomical features of the human body.

Memorable Characters

There are no random characters in the game. Each one has distinct traits and plays a crucial role in the story.

Easter Eggs (References)

Observant players will find numerous references to cult films, games, and even real-life locations in the environment and dialogues.

Multiple Endings

Your choices matter. Your decisions, actions, and even the items you find will determine which of several endings you will witness.

DORM doesn't let you get used to the horror — it changes the rules to keep you on the edge.
